model.title: Uyghur Policy Act of 2026
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. John Curtis (R-UT)

summary.text: The bill would establish policies aimed at supporting human rights for Uyghurs and other minority groups in China's Xinjiang region, while working to protect their cultural and ethnic identity. It would address concerns about religious freedom, labor practices, and political representation for these communities.
